question: Can every retained P4BL profile drive a deterministic physical-scale random-phase field whose intrinsic and simulated 1um-aperture periodograms reproduce the measured spectra exactly enough for an offline second-order reference, without amplitude renormalization or microscopic-geometry claims?

branch_rule.pass: Retain one offline historical B&W second-order field synthesizer and open a separately frozen finite-window/radial-estimator robustness leaf before any image-space diagnostic.
branch_rule.fail: Close measured-NPS field synthesis without changing grid, pitch, phase normalization, spectra or gates; retain P4BL analytic profiles only.

forbidden: renormalize a realized field to force target variance
interpret fixed-amplitude random phase as measured particle geometry or a Gaussian marginal
claim tile or crop invariance for the global FFT reference
combine with P4BJ or Kodak amplitudes
apply the field to photographs or product rendering
claim_ceiling: Deterministic offline random-phase fields reproducing the retained historical Fuji B&W second-order spectra on a 1um periodic grid; not microscopic grain geometry, finite-window photographic validation, modern stock calibration, colour-film structure or product rendering.
